Looking for a Poki Alternative? Here's What BrowserGames100 Offers

Poki and CrazyGames are well-known browser gaming platforms, and they have huge catalogs. But bigger doesn't always mean better. If you've found those sites overwhelming, slow to load, or frustrating to navigate, BrowserGames100 was built as a cleaner, faster alternative.

We focus on three things: game quality, page performance, and a straightforward browsing experience. You won't find endless category pages that lead to dead links, games that don't load, or confusing navigation that makes it hard to find what you actually want to play.

What Makes BrowserGames100 Different From Poki?

Manual curation: Every game in our catalog is tested before it goes live. We remove games that don't work, load too slowly, or deliver a poor experience. Poki and similar sites often auto-import thousands of games without this level of review.

Performance focus: BrowserGames100 is optimized for fast load times, especially on Chromebooks and school networks. We use CDN delivery, lazy loading, and compressed assets to get games in front of you as quickly as possible.

Clean interface: Our site is designed to put games front and center. The layout is straightforward — browse by category, search by title, or check trending games. No confusing menus, no mandatory account creation pop-ups.

Does BrowserGames100 Have the Same Games as Poki?

Many popular HTML5 games appear on multiple platforms since developers license their games to various portals. You'll find many titles on BrowserGames100 that also appear on Poki, including popular action, puzzle, and racing games. You'll also find games exclusive to our platform and sourced from game networks that Poki doesn't work with.
